collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-05  -  THE NEST ABOVE THE PATH SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A gardener discovers that a pair of birds has built a nest in branches over a frequently used path.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A gardener discovers that a pair of birds has built a nest in branches over a frequently used path.

choices.label: Ask Villagers to Use Another Route Temporarily.
Observe the Nest from a Respectful Distance.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The birds continue nesting undisturbed while villagers take a slightly longer walk.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Some villagers forget the change, so the gardener places a visible marker nearby.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A curious child learns why watching quietly is better than approaching the nest.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The gardener completes other work until the nesting season passes.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A falling branch creates concern, and the gardener carefully redirects foot traffic.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The watcher suggests a safer distance for observing the nest.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Neither knows how long the birds will remain, so they agree to be patient.

b1__fx.name: Outcome B1
b1__fx.text: The gardener records the birds' habits without disturbing them.

b1__text.name: Outcome B1
b1__text.text: The gardener records the birds' habits without disturbing them.
